# AgentLaunch Community

> MIT-licensed Next.js 16 + Supabase SaaS starter built for AI coding agents: typed feature modules, owner-only row-level security proven by pgTAP tests, and a read-only setup check (`pnpm run doctor`).

Rules for agents live in AGENTS.md at the repository root. Read it before changing code.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO#readme): quickstart, scripts, project structure
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules and step-by-step recipes (CRUD feature, RLS table, design tokens)
- [Local Supabase](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/blob/main/docs/LOCAL_SUPABASE.md): local stack, migrations, seed, pgTAP
- [Auth setup](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/blob/main/docs/AUTH_SETUP.md): email auth, social providers, callback, rate limits
- [Email and analytics](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/blob/main/docs/EMAIL_AND_ANALYTICS.md): Resend/SMTP, welcome email, Plausible/GA, cookie consent
- [Deploy](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/blob/main/docs/DEPLOY.md): Vercel, Docker, Railway, Fly
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/blob/main/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)
- [Security checklist](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/blob/main/docs/SECURITY_CHECKLIST.md)
- [Feature matrix](https://github.com/OWNER/REPO/blob/main/docs/FEATURE_MATRIX.md): what Community and Pro include

## Key files
- src/lib/permissions/auth.ts: requireUser()/getCurrentUser(); call in every data path
- src/features/projects/: reference feature (schema.ts, queries.ts, actions.ts, components/)
- supabase/migrations/: schema, grants and RLS; supabase/tests/: authorization tests
- src/app/globals.css: design tokens
